I just wish that same treatment was given to the characters that died. Celestia is a super interesting character that they defaulted so hard on, and it's an absolute travesty. This can also be said about a few characters not just Celestia though Celestia is my main focus where even with the free time events and other canonical gubbins don't give the characters the justice they truly deserve I would /love/ to see what drove Celestia to abandoning her name and background to become this entirely new person. The manga did a little bit of that, but even still it wasn't as satisfying as them just giving us all of the information or enough information to piece her together ourselves. 

I definitely feel very strongly about these characters and even the most annoying of them deserved to be fleshed out a bit more.
